apps.name: Draw by Starlight
apps.subtitle: Learn the night sky by drawing it
apps.localizedDescription: Learn the constellations by drawing them, star to star, in tonight's real sky. A line that belongs stays and names its stars; pause, and the next star glimmers. When the figure is whole, its story, quoted from Wikipedia. No account, no network, nothing counted: everything stays on your iPhone. A work in progress.
